Review conditions. Screens use controlled frontend API fixtures, a fixed 15 September 2026 clock and reduced motion. The fictional campus illustration is decorative. 32 new browser checks and 99 existing web checks pass (131 total); production build, typechecks, lint and API/PHP static gates pass. Landing source hashes are unchanged and the current cold/client-navigation comparison has zero differing pixel channels. Screenshots do not certify a live backend, native devices, WebSockets or screen-reader behaviour. Exact status and research limitations are recorded in web-page-tracker.md and student-services-redesign.md.
